traits.name: Aquatic Echolocation
traits.text: An orca can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.

traits.name: Deep Breath
traits.text: An orca can hold its breath for 2 hours.

traits.name: Aquatic Ambush
traits.text: ⬻ 30 feet. An orca can travel no further than 5 feet onto land as part of an Aquatic Ambush. After it does so, it is prone until it Crawls to return to the water.

traits.name: Breach
traits.text: ⬺ The orca Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 feet in the air, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the orca splashes back down into the water.
